raw_segments.text: And when they have emptied and swept clean the soul of him, who is now in their power,
and who is being initiated by them in great mysteries, the next thing is to bring back
to their house insolence and anarchy and waste and impudence in bright array having garlands
on their heads, and a great company with them, himming their praises and calling them by
Insolence they term breeding, and anarchy liberty, and waste magnificence, and impudence
And so the young man passes out of his original nature, which was trained in the school of
necessity, into the freedom and libertinism of useless and unnecessary pleasures.
